fusions.name: Hamstring Pass
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage, slows the target by 15% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Textbook Flank
fusions.desc: A flanking rush through a cone 4 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores their resistances.

fusions.name: Second Run
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Learned by the Litter
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
